from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_traj import Session

INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
OUT = "/app/output/trajectory.npz"

s = Session("stack_bowls_two", instance=INSTANCE)
env = s.env
bowl1 = env.bowl1
bowl2 = env.bowl2
base = bowl1.get_pose().p.copy()
target = np.r_[base[:2], 0.77, [0.0, 0.70710678, 0.70710678, 0.0]]
print("initial", s.status(), "bowl1", bowl1.get_pose().p, "bowl2", bowl2.get_pose().p, flush=True)
print("target bowl2 functional point", target, flush=True)
print("left grasp candidate", env.choose_grasp_pose(bowl2, "left", pre_dis=0.10, target_dis=0.0), flush=True)

s.record_start()
print("grasp", env.move(env.grasp_actor(bowl2, "left", pre_grasp_dis=0.10, grasp_dis=0.0)), "plan", env.plan_success, flush=True)
if env.plan_success:
    print("lift", env.move(env.move_by_displacement("left", z=0.08)), "plan", env.plan_success, flush=True)
if env.plan_success:
    placement = env.place_actor(bowl2, "left", target, functional_point_id=0,
                                pre_dis=0.12, dis=0.005, is_open=True,
                                constrain="free")
    print("place", env.move(placement), "plan", env.plan_success, flush=True)
if env.plan_success:
    print("retreat", env.move(env.move_by_displacement("left", z=0.08)), "plan", env.plan_success, flush=True)
    print("open right", env.move(env.open_gripper("right")), "plan", env.plan_success, flush=True)

acts = s.record_stop()
print("recorded", acts.shape, "status", s.status(), flush=True)
print("final positions", bowl1.get_pose().p, bowl2.get_pose().p, flush=True)
if s.status()["success"]:
    replay = s.replay(acts)
    print("replay", replay, flush=True)
    if replay["success"]:
        s.save_trajectory(acts, OUT, meta={"method": "grasp bowl2 and stack on bowl1", "target": target.tolist()})
        print("saved", OUT, flush=True)
    else:
        raise RuntimeError("recorded trajectory succeeded but replay failed")
else:
    raise RuntimeError("trajectory attempt did not satisfy task predicate")
